description: This plot illustrates the "Massive Activation of atten_output_gate" by displaying the maximum activation values of different network components across layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with data ranging from 0 to 23, displaying numeric tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 50. The plot contains four lines, none of which utilize markers. The "attn_output" metric is represented by a blue dashed line that begins near 0 at Layer 0, remains relatively flat and below 20 until Layer 17, shows minor fluctuations such as reaching approximately 30 at Layer 20, and then rises sharply to end at approximately 110 at Layer 23. The "attn_residual" metric is shown as an orange dotted line that starts near 0 at Layer 0, exhibits a steady, gradual increase to approximately 60 at Layer 16 and 140 at Layer 21, before spiking to end at approximately 260 at Layer 23. A third line, depicted with a green dash-dot style (corresponding to an obscured legend label), starts near 0 at Layer 0, remains flat and below 20 for the majority of the x-axis, and sharply increases after Layer 21 to end at approximately 160 at Layer 23. Finally, the "ffn_residual" metric is a red solid line that begins near 0 at Layer 0, steadily increases in a trajectory nearly identical to the orange dotted line until Layer 21 where it reaches approximately 140, and then exhibits a dramatic spike to end at a peak value of approximately 385 at Layer 23.
